name: A season's maps
description: PUBLIC, and from the moment an upload succeeds: every board a season has, in play or not, in the order they were added. A disabled board is listed, marked, because matches were played on it and a competitor reading a replay is owed the board it names; an upload not yet enabled is listed the same way. `?enabled=true` narrows to the boards in play, and `?boards=true` adds each board itself -- the cartridge's file, as uploaded -- which is what a page drawing every board wants in one call rather than one per map.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'season', se.slug, 'maps', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(CASE WHEN ($4)::text = 'true' THEN (season_map_json(sm)::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('board', sm.board))::json ELSE season_map_json(sm) END ORDER BY sm.added_at, sm.map_id) FROM season_maps sm WHERE sm.season_id = se.id AND (($3)::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR sm.enabled)), '[]'::json)) AS body FROM seasons se JOIN games g ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text
